ValidationRule.description: Blocks direct reassignment to Engineering when transfer information has not been submitted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), Transfer_Submitted_To_Engineering__c = FALSE, NOT( ISBLANK(TEXT(OwnerId)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case transfer to Engineering is incomplete. Use the Case Transfer to Engineering process to complete the required handoff information before reassigning the Case.
